Question: On a dark and stormy night Snoopy suddenly saw a flash of lightning. Ten seconds later he heard the sound of thunder. The speed of sound is \(1088\) feet per second and one mile is \(5280\) feet. Estimate, to the nearest half-mile, how far Snoopy was from the flash of lightning.
